PrCommandPort.docs: Typed driven port for PR command execution; the usecase interactor validates legacy driver-facing primitives into PrCommand before crossing this boundary. Filesystem, Git/GitHub, terminal, and polling operations intentionally complete inline at this synchronous blocking CLI boundary.

SignalActiveTrackResolverPort.docs: SignalCommandInteractor owns active-track discovery through this synchronous single-operation secondary port. Add unrelated discovery concerns as separate ports; implementations and focused doubles evolve only with this operation. The operation's producible error subset is SignalCommandPortError::{RepositoryDiscovery, BranchAbsent, BranchReadFailure}.

SignalCommandPort.docs: SignalCommandInteractor owns resolved command dispatch through this synchronous single-operation secondary port. Active-track and spec-path resolution evolve through their dedicated ports; implementations and focused doubles change only with execute.

SignalGateConfigPort.docs: Synchronous driven port for loading one local SignalGateMatrix. The bounded single-file read completes before command dispatch, so the contract remains synchronous.

SignalSpecPathResolverPort.docs: SignalCommandInteractor owns Signal spec-path resolution through this synchronous single-operation secondary port. Add unrelated path concerns as separate ports; implementations and focused doubles evolve only with this operation. The operation's producible error subset is SignalCommandPortError::{RepositoryDiscovery, SpecPathResolution}.

PrBaseOverride.docs: Usecase-boundary value object for an explicitly supplied PR base override. It owns the exact-nonempty invariant and preserves accepted text without normalization; reconnaissance found no existing value object with that invariant.

PrCommand.docs: Typed application command for the PR command family. Its variant set is intentionally closed and exhaustive; workspace consumers must match every variant, so additions require coordinated compiler-checked updates.

PrCommandInteractor.docs: Dependency-bearing implementation of the existing PrCommandService primary port; replaces seven injected execution closures with one typed PrCommandPort and owns primitive-to-command validation.

PrCommandOutput.docs: Baseline-identical usecase output DTO reused by the PR port, interactor, and driver to preserve stdout, stderr, and exit-code behavior. Optional String fields carry truly opaque presentation text with no domain invariant; u8 exactly models the existing process exit-code range.

PrIdentifier.docs: Usecase-boundary value object for a non-empty GitHub PR number or selector. Reconnaissance found no existing typed PR selector; the raw String accepted by try_new is only the unvalidated transport representation and is never stored or passed as the PR concept before validation.

PrPollIntervalSeconds.docs: Usecase-boundary value object for the PR polling interval in seconds. The interval concept is stable across wait-and-merge and review-polling operations, owns the seconds-unit distinction without a rejecting value invariant, and is independent of CLI syntax, workflow mechanics, persistence, and infrastructure.

PrPollTimeoutSeconds.docs: Usecase-boundary value object for the PR polling timeout in seconds. The timeout concept is stable across wait-and-merge and review-polling operations, owns the seconds-unit distinction without a rejecting value invariant, and is independent of CLI syntax, workflow mechanics, persistence, and infrastructure.

PrReviewCycleMode.docs: Finite usecase-boundary value selecting whether a PR review cycle starts fresh or resumes saved trigger state. Its Start and Resume variant set is intentionally closed and exhaustive; workspace consumers must match every variant, so additions require coordinated compiler-checked updates.

PrTrackIdOverride.docs: Usecase-boundary value object for the optional PR track-id argument. It preserves arbitrary transport text without validation or normalization and remains distinct from the validated domain TrackId; reconnaissance found no equivalent boundary type.

ResolvedSignalChainCommand.docs: Closed and exhaustive resolved command vocabulary accepted by SignalCommandPort.

SignalChainExecutionReport.docs: Completed Signal operation report containing a structured outcome and opaque presentation text.

SignalCommand.docs: Closed and exhaustive driver-facing Signal command vocabulary.

SignalCommandInteractor.docs: SignalService implementation backed by the segregated Signal command, active-track, spec-path, and gate-config secondary ports; sole fail-closed policy enforcement owner.

SignalCommandOutput.docs: Baseline-identical usecase output DTO reused by the Signal port, interactor, and driver to preserve stdout, stderr, and exit-code behavior. Optional String fields carry truly opaque presentation text with no domain invariant; u8 exactly models the existing process exit-code range.

SignalCommandPortError.docs: Closed execution-port failure identities; diagnostic-bearing variants carry opaque, sanitized adapter-boundary reason text.

SignalFailureReason.docs: Application-boundary wrapper for opaque, adapter-sanitized diagnostic text; the text has no constrained domain vocabulary.

SignalGateConfigError.docs: Closed and exhaustive gate-configuration error taxonomy. Each reason is opaque, sanitized diagnostic text owned by the adapter boundary.

SignalGateName.docs: Application-boundary gate selector. The Commit and Merge variant set is intentionally closed and exhaustive; adding a gate requires coordinated match updates.

SignalRootSelection.docs: Closed and exhaustive usecase-boundary root-selection value with distinct supplied-path and discovery identities; a supplied path retains its exact value, including an empty path.

SignalStrictOverride.docs: Application-boundary value object preserving the two legal meanings of the CLI strict flag: use the selected gate-matrix cell or force strict. It prevents a transport bool from leaking into policy resolution.
